feifei_v4_idle.png:
The attached reference IS this character. Copy her exactly: creamy off-white body fur, dark seal-brown mask over her muzzle and around the eyes, dark brown ears, paws and tail, bright BLUE almond eyes, pink blush strokes on her cheeks, plum-purple short kimono jacket with tied-back sleeves, black sash, dark leggings, the belt of small bamboo needle-tubes, and the dark cloth collar around her neck.

**PROPORTIONS - copy these from the reference exactly, this is the most important instruction.**
She is a SMALL, ROUND, CUTE KITTEN mascot:
  - Her HEAD is BIG and ROUND - roughly as large as her whole body.
  - Her LEGS are SHORT and STUBBY. Her body is SHORT and SQUAT. She has NO NECK.
  - Her paws are small and rounded.
Do NOT make her slim. Do NOT give her long legs. Do NOT draw adult or realistic cat anatomy. Do NOT stretch her body or make her tall. If she looks like a grown-up cat, it is wrong - she should look small, chubby and cute. Her narrow muzzle and large pointed ears are the only Siamese features; everything else is short and round.

**HER HAIR - copy it from the reference exactly.** A tuft of dark seal-brown hair grows on top of her head: a FRINGE lying forward over her FOREHEAD between and in front of her ears (clearly visible from the front, its ragged tips coming down toward her eyebrows), gathered and tied behind it, with a short spiky PONYTAIL sticking up and back from the tie, and a PLUM-PURPLE ribbon BOW at the tie. Drawn as solid flat shapes with thick black outlines, not wispy strands.

Pose: standing on both feet, relaxed and alert, one paw resting near the needle tubes at her belt.

Full body, feet at the very bottom edge of the picture, filling the frame vertically. Do not draw her floating. Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no border. Exactly ONE character.
**THE ONE THING YOU CHANGE: the angle.** The reference shows her facing the viewer. Draw the same cat turned into a THREE-QUARTER VIEW FACING RIGHT: her muzzle, nose and gaze all point toward the RIGHT edge of the picture, so you see the right-hand side of her face and the line of her cheek. She does not look at the viewer and never toward the left edge. Her tail trails off to the LEFT behind her. Everything else - proportions, hair, colours, outfit - stays exactly as the reference.
THE HAIR AND GEAR are attached to her and move with her - never detached, never doubled, never swapped to the other side.
THE EYES: both the same size and shape, large blue almond eyes with one glossy white highlight each.
If any enemy appears, it is a small grey rat or a small orange tabby bandit cat - NEVER another copy of the hero and never anything that looks like him. Enemies stay small and near the edges so the hero is clearly the main subject filling the centre.
Any glow, aura, sheen, sparkle, magical light, mist, smoke, steam, breath, dust cloud, shockwave or water in this picture must be WARM GOLDEN AMBER, CREAMY WHITE or WARM GREY - never green, never greenish - and drawn solid and opaque, never see-through. (The picture sits on a green screen: anything green or transparent gets erased by the chroma key and leaves a hole.)
Style: thick black outlines, FLAT colours with only subtle soft shading - do NOT render it painterly, do NOT use heavy airbrushed shadows or a rendered-illustration look. Cute cartoon, not photorealistic.
THE FACE ESPECIALLY: draw the face in FLAT blocks of colour with hard edges between them. Where two fur colours meet that is a CLEAN EDGE, never a soft airbrushed fade and never a blurry gradient. No shaded blob around the muzzle, no glow on the cheeks.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.

Output 896x896 PNG. Save the image as feifei_v4_idle.png in the current directory and report the path.
